preview_descriptions.latent_fit: 这4个训练窗口的目标已参与直接优化Z；展示的是固定Decoder的拟合诊断，不是Encoder正常输出，也不是样本外结果。

precision: Decoder training BF16 neural/FP32 loss; all evaluation FP32. Direct latent optimization uses fullFP32 to avoid BF16 obscuring smallZ updates; TF32off throughout.
initialization: All use identical frozen sourceEncoder andPriceDecoder. Matched fresh pair starts seed42 with identical temporal/position/geometry parameters, zero output weights andsame training-only meanquantity bias; freshAdam. Warm original retains sourceQuantityDecoder andoriginalAdam as extra historical reference, notmatched fresh-init control.
decoder_contract: Fresh original vs fresh query is primary architecture comparison: samefixedZ,loss,indices/order,seed42,2048updates,effectivebatch4,AdamW1e-4,clip1. Query count is0.60%smaller, notlarger. No old spatial feature orEncoder bypass inquery. Compare against warmreference beforeclaiming useful gain.
primary: Fixed2048endpoint quantityRMSE, actual10/100BTCprecision/recall/FP,dynamics on16development+8seen. Retain checkpoints andprice metrics. Query must improve againstfresh original ANDnot merely beat a degradedfresh baseline relative towarm original.

latent_diagnostic.initialization: Source Encoder posterior means, no random restarts
latent_diagnostic.objective: Same original shape_mass price+quantity+Top16+mass objective, beta0; noZpenalty. Only4*8192 freeZscalars receiveupdates; ALL modelparameters/buffers fixed.
latent_diagnostic.interpretation: Training-target-assisted expressibility diagnosis, not production/OOS inference. Report eachwindow andpooled priceguard plusZnorm/drift. Improvement withhuge off-manifoldZ orprice degradation isnot a successful full-book reconstruction. Failure tofit isnot proof of structural impossibility.

selection: seed42only; reused2025Q1 development fordecoder controls;2025Q2 and2026 untouched. DirectZ diagnostic usesonly4predeclaredtrainingwindows.
authorization: User explicitly requested both decoder-isolation experiments. Three2048update decoder lanes plusone1024cycle four-window latent-fit lane; GPUs2–5;4hour ceiling.

report.title: Decoder隔离实验：固定Z读出对照与直接优化Z
report.scope: 上表比较三种固定Encoder/价格Decoder的训练；下方独立展示4个训练窗的直接Z拟合。
report.introduction: 主对照为重新初始化的原Decoder与非线性坐标查询Decoder，参数量相差0.60%，初始数量均为同一个训练均值常数。两组采用相同训练预算与新Adam状态；预训练原Decoder保留作额外质量参考。
report.hardware: GPU2原预训练参考、GPU3原Decoder重新初始化、GPU4查询Decoder重新初始化、GPU5固定Decoder直接拟合4个训练窗口的Z。
report.future: 直接优化Z使用真实目标，只是可表达性诊断，不能作为正常推理或开发集成绩。原Decoder拟合失败仍可能来自优化不充分；新Decoder未胜出也不能直接证明latent信息丢失。
